# Fleet

> Connect GitHub, pick a repo, and get a stable live URL — with build logs, env vars, push-to-deploy, and zero-downtime rollouts.

Fleet is a deployment platform for Docker-based applications. It connects to GitHub via OAuth, lets users pick a repository and branch, then automatically clones the code, builds a Docker image, and runs the container behind a stable subdomain URL.

## What Fleet does

- GitHub OAuth integration — connect your account and browse repos directly
- Automatic Docker image build from your repository's Dockerfile
- Stable live URL per project (e.g. `https://depl-fleet-{projectId}.yourdomain.com`)
- Push-to-deploy CI/CD via GitHub webhooks — every push to your tracked branch triggers a full redeploy
- Encrypted environment variable injection at container start
- Streaming build logs and runtime logs via SSE
- Zero-downtime rollouts — new container starts before the old one is removed
- Stop, rollback, and delete deployments
